# librawspeed / TiffDecoderFuzzer-DngDecoder

librawspeed's own fuzz target `TiffDecoderFuzzer-DngDecoder` ([source](source/main.cpp), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over rawspeed (darktable-org/rawspeed at c835b05a).

TiffParser::parse, isAppropriateDecoder (result ignored), then the chosen TIFF-based decoder (Arw, Cr2, Dcr, Dcs, Dng, Erf, Iiq, Kdc, Mef, Mos, Nef, Orf, Pef, Rw2, Srw, Sti, Threefr) decodeRaw + decodeMetaData with empty camera metadata; output never checked.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against rawspeed at commit c835b05a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
